reason: As someone who has been burned by an unfulfilled campaign, Document B wins me over by confirming that the art and rules are completely finished, walking through the exact math of how the $28,000 goal covers printing and shipping, and providing a realistic delivery date. Document A leaves out those critical de-risking details and even makes the naive claim that designing the game is 'the hard part,' which is a huge red flag for a first-time creator facing manufacturing and fulfillment.
